entries.text: Fixed TPC-Havoc Q20 variants taking about 20s each at scale 0.01 on PostgreSQL-family engines because the correlated lineitem subquery was re-scanned for every partsupp row; the rewrite now joins a grouped lineitem subquery.

Fixed JOB query 8c failing on TimescaleDB with 'could not resize shared memory segment' by raising the container shared memory to 2 GiB, and JOB query 18a running out of DuckDB memory on pg_mooncake by raising duckdb.max_memory from the 4 GiB default to 10 GiB.
